title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize modern data platforms that enable analytics, reporting, operational intelligence, and AI-driven solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will work across the full data lifecycle, developing scalable data pipelines, integrating complex data sources, and delivering high-quality data solutions that support business and customer objectives. You will collaborate with architects, engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to modernize data environments and implement cloud-based data platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate is both a strong technical practitioner and a problem solver who enjoys working with modern data technologies, navigating ambiguity, and delivering scalable solutions in dynamic environments.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the technical leader for our data engineering initiatives.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver data from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources.
* Build and support ETL/ELT solutions across cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, lakehouses, and analytics environments.
* Develop data integration frameworks that enable reliable, secure, and efficient movement of data across systems.
* Design and implement dimensional models, transformation logic, and data structures that support analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives.
* Work with modern cloud data technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, and related platforms.
* Collaborate with architects and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Apply data quality, testing, monitoring, lineage, and governance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Optimize data pipelines and data platforms for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Support modernization initiatives involving legacy data platforms, data warehouses, and integration technologies.
* Implement modern engineering practices including source control, automated testing, deployment automation, and CI/CD processes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across data platforms and integration environments.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, solution design discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay current with evolving technologies, industry trends, and emerging approaches within data engineering, analytics, and AI.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Integration, Analytics Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong experience designing, building, and supporting production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions.
* Advanced SQL skills, including query optimization, performance tuning, and data modeling.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Solid experience developing data solutions using Python, Scala, Java, or similar programming languages.
* Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, lakehouses, and modern analytics environments.
* Experience with distributed data processing technologies such as Spark or equivalent frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with Git-based development workflows and CI/CD practices.
* Understanding of data quality, governance, lineage, security, and observability concepts.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities, learn new technologies quickly, and succeed in fast-paced environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Databricks and Snowflake in production environments.
* Experience with Databricks and modern lakehouse architectures.
* Experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks.
* Experience modernizing enterprise data warehouses and legacy integration environments.
* Experience with Azure Data Services or equivalent cloud-native data technologies.
* Experience supporting machine learning, artificial intelligence, or advanced analytics initiatives.
* Familiarity with semantic modeling, analytics-ready data structures, and data product concepts.
* Experience implementing data governance, metadata management, or data lineage solutions.

**About Netrio**
Netrio is a leading MSP in North America, specializing in IT solutions for small- to mid-market enterprises. We serve over 1,000 clients across industries with services including managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, connectivity, voice, and custom application development.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About TVARIT**
TVARIT GmbH specializes in developing and delivering cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the metal industry, including steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and more. Our software products empower customers to make intelligent, data-driven decisions, driving advancements in Predictive Quality (PsQ), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Energy Consumption Reduction (PsE), etc. With a strong portfolio of renowned reference customers, state-of-the-art technology, a talented research team from prestigious universities, and recognition through esteemed awards such as the EU Horizon 2020 AI Prize, TVARIT is recognized as one of the most innovative AI companies in Germany and Europe. We are seeking a self-motivated individual with a positive "can-do" attitude and excellent oral and written communication skills in English to join our team.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Databricks, PySpark, and distributed computing to develop and optimize scalable ETL pipelines for manufacturing analytics. The role involves working with high-frequency industrial data to enable real-time and batch data processing
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build scalable real-time and batch processing workflows using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and Apache Spark.
* Perform data pre-processing, including cleaning, transformation, deduplication, normalization, encoding, and scaling to ensure high-quality input for downstream analytics.
* Design and maintain cloud-based data architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses, and warehouses, following Medallion Architecture.
* Deploy and optimize data solutions on Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP with a focus on performance, security, and scalability.
* Develop and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured data from IoT, MES, SCADA, LIMS, and ERP systems.
* Automate data workflows using CI/CD and DevOps best practices, ensuring security and compliance with industry standards
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance data pipelines for high availability and reliability.
* Utilize Docker and Kubernetes for scalable data processing.
* Collaborate with automation team, data scientists and engineers to provide clean, structured data for AI/ML models.

Desired Skills and Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 4+ years of experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on cloud platforms such as Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP
* Proficiency in PySpark, Azure Databricks, Python and Apache Spark, etc.
* Expertise in relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), time series databases (e.g. Influx DB), and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra)
* Experience in containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Good to have MLOps, DevOps including model lifecycle management
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work effectively as a team player.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment, adapting quickly to changing priorities and responsibilities.

title: AWS Data Engineer – Python, Databases, Capital Markets & DevOps
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking an AWS Data Engineer with a 70% focus on data engineering and a 30% focus on DevOps to design, develop, deploy, and support scalable data solutions on AWS.
  
  
The role requires strong AWS knowledge, advanced Python development skills, robust database expertise, and an understanding of capital markets, including Fixed Income instruments and related financial concepts. The AWS Data Engineer will work with relational, columnar, and vector databases while supporting cloud infrastructure, CI/CD processes, and reliable application delivery.
  
  
This position contributes to business objectives by delivering secure and scalable data solutions, improving database performance, supporting capital markets capabilities, strengthening deployment processes, and enabling reliable access to high-quality data.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* AWS services and cloud infrastructure: Proven experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting applications and data solutions on AWS.
* Python: Strong professional experience writing clean, efficient, reliable, maintainable, and testable Python code.
* Relational databases: Extensive experience with relational database technologies, including MySQL and PostgreSQL.
* Columnar databases and data formats: Experience with Amazon Redshift and Apache Parquet.
* Vector databases: Experience working with vector databases to support project requirements, search, analytics, or data retrieval.
* Database design and optimization: Knowledge of schema design, indexing, query optimization, data modeling, and database architecture.
* Data engineering: Experience developing data solutions, managing data flows, and working with structured and semi-structured data.
* DevOps: Ability to support cloud deployments, infrastructure activities, CI/CD processes, troubleshooting, and operational reliability.
* Capital markets: Knowledge of capital markets, including Fixed Income instruments and related financial concepts.
* Software development practices: Knowledge of software development best practices, design principles, testing, version control, and technical documentation.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* AWS certifications relevant to data engineering, cloud architecture, or DevOps.
* Experience with data modeling and data warehousing.
* Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with infrastructure automation and cloud deployment processes.
* Understanding of additional financial instruments and capital markets concepts.
* Experience supporting data-intensive applications in financial services or related environments.

****Overall Responsibilities****

* Develop and deploy scalable applications and data solutions on the AWS cloud platform.
* Write clean, efficient, reliable, and maintainable Python code for data processing, application services, automation, and operational support.
* Design, implement, maintain, and optimize relational, columnar, and vector databases.
* Apply database design and architecture best practices to support performance, scalability, availability, data quality, and maintainability.
* Develop data and application solutions related to capital markets and Fixed Income instruments.
* Build and support data models, schemas, data flows, data warehouse structures, and data access processes.
* Contribute to DevOps activities, including deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure support, monitoring, and release processes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, data requirements, solution designs, and delivery priorities.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, data, database, cloud infrastructure, and deployment issues.
* Review technical designs and recommend improvements to application architecture, database performance, cloud usage, and operational processes.
* Apply secure development, access management, data protection, and operational control practices.
* Support efficient use of AWS compute, storage, database, and data processing resources to promote cost and environmental sustainability.

**Performance Outcomes and Expectations**

* AWS applications and data solutions are delivered in accordance with defined functional, technical, security, and operational requirements.
* Python code meets agreed standards for reliability, maintainability, testability, performance, and documentation.
* Database schemas, queries, data models, and storage structures support required performance and scalability.
* Relational, columnar, and vector database solutions are implemented appropriately for project needs.
* Data solutions accurately support capital markets and Fixed Income use cases.
* CI/CD and DevOps processes improve deployment consistency, traceability, and operational reliability.
* Technical issues are investigated systematically, resolved within agreed priorities, and documented for future reference.
* Cloud resources are used efficiently through appropriate architecture, monitoring, capacity planning, and optimization.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Strong Python programming skills for application development, data processing, automation, testing, and cloud-based solutions.
* Ability to write clean, efficient, reliable, modular, and maintainable code.
* Experience applying software development best practices, design principles, error handling, testing, and documentation.
* Ability to develop code that supports data-intensive applications and capital markets requirements.

****Preferred****

* Experience with additional programming or scripting languages used for data engineering, DevOps, or cloud automation.
* Experience developing reusable Python libraries, services, and automation frameworks.
* Experience with asynchronous, distributed, or event-driven application development.

**Databases and Data Management**
****Essential****

* Extensive knowledge of relational databases, including MySQL and PostgreSQL.
* Experience with columnar databases, including Amazon Redshift.
* Experience working with Apache Parquet and columnar data storage formats.
* Experience with vector databases.
* Knowledge of database schema design, normalization, partitioning, indexing, and query optimization.
* Understanding of data modeling, data quality, data lifecycle management, and data access patterns.
* Ability to select appropriate database technologies based on performance, scalability, query, storage, and project requirements.
* Understanding of data structures and data management practices relevant to capital markets and Fixed Income instruments.

****Preferred****

* Experience with data warehousing and analytical data models.
* Experience designing data lakes, data warehouses, or hybrid data platforms.
* Experience with data partitioning, compression, archival, and storage optimization.
* Experience with data lineage, metadata management, validation, and reconciliation.
* Experience supporting vector search and retrieval use cases.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Proven experience with AWS services and cloud infrastructure.
* Experience developing and deploying scalable applications and data solutions on AWS.
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts, including compute, storage, networking, databases, identity, monitoring, and resilience.
* Ability to troubleshoot AWS application, data, infrastructure, and deployment issues.
* Understanding of cloud resource management, availability, scalability, and cost considerations.

****Preferred****

* AWS certification relevant to data engineering, cloud architecture, or DevOps.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automated environment provisioning.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, alerting, logging, and performance optimization.
* Experience with serverless, containerized, or event-driven AWS architectures.
* Experience applying cloud sustainability practices through resource optimization and efficient data processing.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Python libraries and frameworks relevant to data engineering, application development, database connectivity, testing, and automation.
* Libraries or tools required to work with relational, columnar, and vector databases.
* Frameworks and utilities that support data ingestion, transformation, validation, and processing.
* Technologies that support the development of capital markets and Fixed Income-related data solutions.

****Preferred****

* Experience with data processing and distributed computing frameworks.
* Experience with database migration, schema management, and data quality frameworks.
* Experience with libraries supporting financial data analysis, instrument reference data, pricing data, or risk-related use cases.
* Experience with frameworks for API development, workflow orchestration, and cloud automation.

**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****

* Knowledge of software development best practices and design principles.
* Experience with source control, code reviews, testing, release management, and technical documentation.
* Ability to contribute to DevOps activities and cloud deployment processes.
* Understanding of CI/CD concepts, automated testing, build processes, deployment controls, and environment management.
* Experience troubleshooting and resolving technical issues across application, database, cloud, and deployment layers.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Experience with observability, logging, metrics, alerting, and operational dashboards.
* Experience with Agile development and iterative delivery practices.

**Security Protocols**
****Essential****

* Understanding of secure software development practices.
* Knowledge of AWS identity and access management, least-privilege access, authentication, and authorization.
* Understanding of database security, encryption, secrets management, and access controls.
* Ability to protect sensitive financial, application, and operational data.
* Awareness of secure coding, vulnerability management, auditability, and secure deployment practices.

****Preferred****

* Experience implementing security controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with cloud security monitoring and configuration assessment.
* Familiarity with data masking, tokenization, and privacy controls.
* Experience supporting applications subject to financial services, regulatory, or audit requirements.

****Experience Requirements****

* Minimum of 7–10 years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, cloud engineering, database engineering, DevOps, or related technology roles.
* Proven experience with AWS services, cloud infrastructure, Python development, and database engineering.
* Extensive experience with relational databases, including MySQL and PostgreSQL; columnar databases, including Amazon Redshift and Apache Parquet; and vector databases.
* Experience with database schema design, data modeling, query optimization, data warehousing, or related data architecture responsibilities.
* Demonstrated experience developing or supporting solutions related to capital markets, including Fixed Income instruments and related financial concepts.
* Experience with DevOps activities, CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, troubleshooting, and operational support is preferred.
* Industry experience in financial services, capital markets, investment technology, or other data-intensive environments is preferred.
* Candidates may qualify through equivalent professional experience, demonstrated technical delivery, relevant certifications, or a combination of data engineering, cloud, database, Python, and capital markets experience.
* The role requires willingness to work the 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM shift.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Develop, test, deploy, and support Python-based data solutions and scalable AWS applications involving relational, columnar, and vector databases.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, data models, capital markets use cases, delivery plans, and operational priorities.
* Review database performance, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD processes, application behavior, and production issues while implementing improvements and resolving defects.
* Make technical decisions within approved standards regarding data architecture, schema design, database optimization, AWS deployment, DevOps practices, and solution maintainability.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 7–10 years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, cloud engineering, database engineering, DevOps, or a related field.
* AWS certifications are preferred but not required where equivalent practical AWS experience is demonstrated.
* Training or practical experience in Python, AWS, database architecture, data modeling, data warehousing, DevOps, CI/CD, and capital markets is preferred.
* Continuous professional development is expected through relevant certifications, technical training, cloud learning, database education, and knowledge of evolving capital markets technology practices.

**Professional Competencies**

* Applies structured analysis and problem-solving to investigate data, database, Python, AWS, application, infrastructure, and deployment issues.
* Works effectively with cross-functional teams, contributes technical knowledge, and supports shared delivery goals across data engineering and DevOps activities.
* Communicates technical requirements, database designs, project risks, financial concepts, issues, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Adapts to changing AWS services, data architectures, database technologies, capital markets requirements, delivery priorities, and operational needs.
* Identifies practical improvements in data architecture, database performance, automation, deployment reliability, resource usage, and solution sustainability.
* Organizes work across development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, production support, and delivery commitments while prioritizing tasks according to business impact.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
As a Data Engineer, you’ll feel at home if you are hands on, grounded, opinionated and passionate about delivering comprehensive data solutions that align with modern data architecture approaches. Your work will range from building a full data platform to building data pipelines or helping with data architecture and strategy. This role is ideal for those looking to have a large impact and huge scope for growth, while still being hands on with technology. We aim to allow growth without becoming “post-technical”
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Data Scientists and Engineers to deliver production quality AI and Machine Learning systems
* Build frameworks and supporting tooling for data ingestion from a complex variety of sources
* Consult with our clients on data strategy, modernising their data infrastructure, architecture and technology
* Model their data for increased visibility and performance
* You will be given ownership of your work, and are encouraged to propose alternatives and make a case for doing things differently; our clients trust us and we manage ourselves.
* You will work in short sprints to deliver working software
* You will be working with other data engineers in Sahaj and work on building Data Engineering capability across the organisation

Skills you’ll need
  
  

* Demonstrated experience as a Senior Data Engineer in complex enterprise environments.
* Deep understanding of technology fundamentals and experience with languages like Python, or functional programming languages like Scala
* Demonstrated experience in design and development of big data applications using tech stacks like Databricks, Apache Spark, HDFS, HBase and Snowflake
* Commendable skills in building data products, by integrating large sets of data from hundreds of internal and external sources would be highly critical
* A nuanced understanding of code quality, maintainability and practices like Test Driven Development
* Ability to deliver an application end to end; having an opinion on how your code should be built, packaged and deployed using CI/CD
* Understanding of Cloud platforms, DevOps, GitOps, Containers

Give yourself an opportunity to
  
  

* Experience a culture of trust, respect and transparency powered by holacracy.
* An environment that will allow you to hone your craft.
* Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams to solve some real business problems.
* Solve problems across different domains. Level-up on difficult problems.
* Find your balance between work and life’s ups and downs with unlimited leave when you really need it.
* Not be exploited, as everyone knows everyone’s salary. Radical pay transparency.
* Own what you build. When Sahaj grows in impact and value, you’ll have a share in that upside.

title: Data Engineer II
description:
**Job Purpose**
Design and deliver robust, scalable data pipelines and infrastructure components that ensure reliable, high-quality data availability for analytics, data science, and AI workloads. The role operates with growing technical ownership, taking end-to-end responsibility for assigned platform domains and contributing meaningfully to architectural decisions and engineering standards.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve data from structured and unstructured sources across cloud environments
* Own assigned pipeline domains end-to-end — from requirements and design through to deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement
* Implement and evolve data models that support analytics, BI, and machine learning consumption requirements
* Build and maintain orchestration workflows using tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, or Azure Data Factory
* Optimize pipeline and query performance across cloud data platforms including Snowflake and Azure Synapse
* Define and implement data quality rules, automated testing, and alerting to ensure reliability and consistency of data outputs

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued
  
  

* Contribute to architectural discussions and platform decisions, providing well-reasoned technical input and trade-off analysis
* Collaborate with Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into maintainable engineering solutions
* Conduct code reviews and support the development of Associate and DE I engineers through practical guidance
* Maintain clear documentation for all assigned pipelines, data models, and infrastructure components

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Fluent in English Language.
* ITIL Certification is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, automation, and pipeline development.
* Working knowledge of data orchestration and transformation tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, dbt).
* Understanding of data modelling techniques — dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schema, and medallion/lakehouse architecture patterns.
* Familiarity with batch and streaming data processing concepts (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Azure Event Hubs).
* Good grasp of software engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), CI/CD practices, and automated testing.
* Ability to communicate technical designs clearly and provide constructive feedback to junior team members.

Work Experience
  
  

* With 4–6 years of hands-on experience in data engineering or a closely related software engineering role
* Demonstrable experience delivering production-grade data pipelines in a cloud environment.
* Solid hands-on experience with cloud data platforms on Azure, AWS, or GCP (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, S3, Redshift, BigQuery).
* Experience with data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake or Azure Synapse, including query optimisation and access control.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
Responsible for designing, building, and optimizing scalable data infrastructure and pipelines on
**Microsoft Fabric**
and
**Snowflake**
that support the organization's data engineering, analytics, and AI capabilities. Serves as a senior technical contributor, driving engineering excellence, ensuring reliable and high-performing data solutions, and providing guidance to junior engineers.

* Own the technical design and implementation of data models across relational and lakehouse architectures — leveraging Fabric OneLake/Lakehouse and Snowflake — to support analytics and ML workloads

* Build and maintain robust orchestration workflows using tools such as Fabric Data Factory pipelines and Snowflake Tasks/Streams
* Define and implement data quality frameworks — validation rules, automated testing, monitoring, and alerting — across assigned pipeline domains in Fabric and Snowflake

* Solid understanding of dimensional and data vault modelling techniques and lakehouse architecture patterns, particularly within the Fabric OneLake and Snowflake ecosystems
* Experience with streaming and batch processing frameworks (e.g., Azure Event Hubs, Snowflake Snowpipe/Streaming)

* Ability to communicate complex technical designs clearly and mentor less experienced engineers effectively
* Strong experience with Snowflake and Microsoft Fabric Warehouse for data warehousing, including performance tuning and access control

Work Experience
  
  

* With 6-8 years of progressive hands-on experience in data engineering, with a demonstrable track record of delivering production-grade data infrastructure on Microsoft Fabric and/or Snowflake

title: Data Engineer - BA4
description:
Join us as a Data Engineer at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be successful as a Senior Software Engineer, you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Overall experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, process mining, business intelligence, data warehousing, or enterprise data platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Celonis, including Data Integration, Data Pools, Data Models, Transformations, Analyses, and Process Mining use cases.
* Strong SQL expertise, including complex joins, window functions, performance tuning, incremental loading, and data quality validation.
* Strong understanding of Celonis Process Query Language (PQL), process mining concepts, event logs, activity tables, case tables, and KPI modelling.
* Experience building scalable data pipelines into Celonis from enterprise systems using connectors, APIs, databases, or scheduled data extracts.
* Good understanding of banking and financial services processes, including KYC, client onboarding, lending, payments, operations, reconciliation, complaints management, risk controls, and regulatory reporting.
* Experience with relational databases and enterprise or cloud data platforms such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, AWS, and Azure.
* Ability to analyse source system data structures and translate business process logic into reliable Celonis data models.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across data load failures, transformation issues, performance bottlenecks, and data inconsistencies.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including documentation, backlog refinement, sprint execution, and stakeholder demonstration.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Celonis certification in Data Engineering, Process Mining, EMS, or related learning tracks.
* Experience with Object-Centric Process Mining and Celonis process intelligence capabilities.
* Exposure to Python, Java, REST APIs, ETL tools, orchestration tools, and automation platforms.
* Experience in enterprise governance, production support, incident management, access management, and release management.
* Knowledge of banking technology controls, data privacy, information security, and audit requirements.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across business, technology, architecture, compliance, and operations.
* Ability to create reusable data engineering patterns, templates, and accelerators for multiple business processes.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To define strategic group objectives of and internal functions including, financial and business strategy, and mergers and acquisitions.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and execution of acquisition, disposal and strategic partnership activities, and other strategic transactions on behalf of the Barclays Group, including the identification of potential acquisition targets, building an acquisition pipeline and identifying non-core businesses and/or assets that can sold to generate value through disposal analysis, as well as maintaining an active coverage model with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitoring and evaluation of the financial performance, market position and strategic fit of potential acquisition and partnership targets. Including (but not limited to) detailed valuation, returns, profitability and cost analysis.
* Development of business cases for potential acquisitions, including financial projections, strategic rationale, and synergy assessments.
* Collaboration across departments to develop deal structures that align to the banks objectives to negotiate deals with potential acquisition targets.
* Management and communication of post-merger integration plans and processes, including culture, operations, and systems.
* Identification of industry trends and developments related to M&A tools and techniques by attending conferences, conducting market research, and participating in training.
* Maintain close dialogue to group strategy, understand the firms' ambitions and market commitments, understand equity analyst's expectations on the firms and how acquisition and disposal activity can provide appropriate levers and dials.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.

**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Field Engineer, Team Lead you will serve as a player-coach — guiding a team of field engineers while personally executing the most complex, mission-critical technical work yourself. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you are both the technical anchor for your team and Addepar's technical vanguard in the field, translating complex business requirements into production-grade integrations, automations, and data solutions.
  
  
You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite — from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling. At the same time, you will develop your people-management skills: providing daily guidance, coordinating work allocation, and turning the vision set by leadership into reality while keeping your team aligned to our core processes. This role combines a forward-deployed delivery model with hands-on technical depth and functional leadership of a high-performing engineering team.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Associate Implementation Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Associate Implementation Engineer works directly with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning both the product configuration and the underlying data migration that make each implementation successful. This role confirms requirements, configures and tests the platform, migrates and validates customer data, and trains users, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and strong data and database expertise, the Associate Implementation Engineer understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including database schema management, ETL configuration, and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach, and partners across teams to ensure a smooth, high-quality implementation that maximizes the value customers realize from OpenGov.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and test OpenGov cloud software to meet the documented implementation requirements of governments across the United States
* Own customer data migration end to end, including database schema management, ETL tool configuration, and scripting as required, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated customer data
* Confirm customer requirements across both configuration and data, and provide guidance, assistance, and support throughout the platform configuration and integration process
* Ensure receipt of appropriate data from customers, map it to OpenGov requirements, and upload, transform, and manipulate it to generate the desired application behaviors
* Build and execute test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
* Interact directly with government Finance staff, Budget Directors, IT personnel etc, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate existing processes that improve customer workflows
* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues throughout the implementation and drive them to timely resolution
* Work closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to facilitate a consistent customer experience and ensure successful projects for customers

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 0 to 1 year of SQL scripting experience
* 0 to 1 year of Python, or similar, scripting experience
* Strong Microsoft Excel and Word skills, including using functions/formulas to format data such as v-lookup, pivot tables, error-checking, and developing properly formatted reports
* Experience with database technologies and with ETL or data-migration concepts and tools will be an advantage
* Excellent interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication skills, teamwork, and customer service mentality
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to customer needs
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to validate and reconcile data for accuracy

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

title: Data Modeler
description:
**About The Role**
**As a
**Data Modeler at TVH**
, you will play a central role in shaping how our global organization structures, understands, and leverages its data. Operating across
**all core business domains**
(e.g., Customer, Supplier, Item, Product, Equipment, HR, Finance, Commercial, Operations, …), you will design, develop, and maintain high-performing Logical Data Models (LDM) and Physical Data Models (PDM) that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational applications.**
**You will translate diverse cross-domain business requirements into clear, standardized, and scalable data structures. Working closely with Domain Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Stewards, you will ensure our logical abstractions align perfectly with business reality while our physical implementations maximize database performance and data accessibility.**
****Key Responsibilities****

* Enterprise Logical & Physical Data Model Design:

+ Design, construct, and maintain normalized Conceptual and Logical Data Models (LDM) across all enterprise domains, establishing clear entities, attributes, relationships, and business definitions.
+ Translate LDMs into optimized Physical Data Models (PDM) tailored for target database platforms, balancing storage efficiency, index strategies, and query performance.
+ Reverse-engineer legacy source systems and translate complex domain requirements into normalized, reusable data structures.
+ Produce and manage comprehensive data documentation, including ERDs (Entity-Relationship Diagrams), data dictionaries, and data mapping lineage.

* Domain Alignment & Standards Governance:

+ Drive consistent data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design patterns across all domain modeling initiatives.
+ Partner with Data Governance teams to incorporate standardized business glossaries and enterprise metadata standards directly into model structures.
+ Conduct data model reviews with technical and business teams to ensure cross-domain consistency and avoid data duplication.

* Cross-Functional Technical Collaboration:

+ Work hand-in-hand with Domain Architects to ensure domain models fit seamlessly into TVH’s target data architecture strategy.
+ Collaborate with Data Engineers to guide the physical realization of models and support optimized ETL/ELT pipeline design.
+ Partner with Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Business Partners to validate logical assumptions, clarify business logic, and refine domain models as needs evolve.

* Model Optimization & Quality:

+ Profile source data using SQL to uncover structural edge cases and validate cardinality before finalizing logical designs.
+ Refine physical schemas for cloud data warehouses, adjusting partitioning, clustering, and denormalization strategies to meet performance SLAs.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience focused specifically on Logical Data Modeling (LDM) and Physical Data Modeling (PDM) across multiple business domains.
* Deep expertise in diverse modeling paradigms: Relational/Entity-Relationship (3NF), Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake), and Denormalization concepts.
* Strong proficiency in SQL for deep source system profiling, data mapping, and schema validation.
* Hands-on experience with modern cloud data warehouses (preferably GCP BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks) and relational database platforms.
* Proficiency with enterprise data modeling tools (e.g., Erwin, PowerDesigner, SqlDBM, or similar).
* Solid understanding of Data Warehousing principles, metadata management, and ETL/ELT architecture.
* Fluent in English with excellent communication skills to articulate complex logical structures to both business stakeholders and engineering teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Data Vault 2.0 modeling methodologies for enterprise scale.
* Exposure to real-time or streaming data modeling patterns (Event-driven architectures).
* Understanding of data privacy impact on data design (e.g., handling PII attributes across global domains).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum distributed software delivery teams.

title: Business Intelligence Senior Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates.
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting.
* Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
* Reduce “blind spots” by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
* Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

title: Databricks Data Engineer
description:

* Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog.

* Support the migration and redesign of SSAS cube-based analytics into Databricks SQL, Delta tables, and modern semantic models.

* 4–7 years of overall data engineering experience.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks on AWS preferred; Azure Databricks experience is also acceptable.
* Strong proficiency in Spark, including PySpark and/or Scala, and SQL.
* Proven experience participating in the migration of on-premises SQL Server data warehouses to cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience converting SSIS-based ETL pipelines into Spark-based data engineering solutions.
* Experience working within structured migration or enterprise modernization initiatives rather than solely lift-and-shift projects.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and analytical workloads.
* Experience with Delta Lake, incremental processing patterns, and data versioning.
* Familiarity with Databricks Workflows, Jobs, and production-grade deployments.
* Practical experience with performance tuning and large-volume data processing.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience modernizing SSAS cube-based reporting solutions into Lakehouse-native semantic models.
* Exposure to Databricks SQL Warehouses and BI integrations, with Power BI experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of Medallion architecture and cloud-native data engineering practices aligned with Databricks best practices.
* Familiarity with MLflow, feature engineering, feature stores, or other AI/ML capabilities within Databricks.

We are committed to creating an environment where associates are supported, challenged, and provided opportunities to grow and develop their careers over the long term.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
**About Gen**
Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.
  
  
Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.
  
  
When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.
  
  
At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.
  
  
If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an exceptional Staff Data Engineer to join our team as a senior technical leader responsible for architecting and implementing enterprise-scale data solutions that directly impact our cybersecurity platform's strategic objectives. This role combines deep technical expertise with significant organizational influence, requiring someone who can design complex data architectures, mentor engineering teams, and drive the technical vision for our multi-petabyte data infrastructure serving millions of users.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Expertise with Apache Kafka, real-time data processing, and event-driven architectures
* Experience with Apache Iceberg, data lakehouse architectures, and modern table formats
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud cost optimization and data warehouse performance tuning
* Design and architect enterprise-scale data solutions that directly impact Gen's data strategy execution. This might be something like designing and implementing an incremental identity graph, integrating a marketing attribution vendor or automating LTV calculation.
* Lead evaluation and implementation of cutting-edge technologies including modern data stack and advanced analytics
* Collaborate with executives and senior leadership to align data architecture with business strategy
* Mentor IC9 and IC10 engineers, focusing on architectural decision-making and advanced technical skills
* Drive complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives requiring coordination across multiple engineering teams

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or related technical field (master's degree preferred)
* Minimum 10-15 years of hands-on data engineering experience in large-scale, high-volume environments
* Expert-level proficiency in SQL optimization for multi-petabyte datasets and advanced Python programming
* Extensive experience with Snowflake architecture, optimization, and cost management at enterprise scale
* Demonstrated expertise building Kimball dimensional data warehouses and star schema architectures
* Advanced experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and either DBT or SQLMesh for data transformations
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitFlow, and data governance frameworks ensuring GDPR/PCI-DSS compliance
* Proven ability to architect and own multiple entire areas of the codebase or services independently
* Experience with MLOps frameworks, LLM integration, vector databases, and AI-driven analytics. We know its new, but some familiarity is a plus.
* Proven track record with subscription business models including cohort analysis, LTV calculations, and marketing attribution
* Direct industry experience in cybersecurity, ad-tech, or high-volume data processing environments (billions of events per day)
* This position requires a unique combination of deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, and leadership capabilities. The successful candidate will be a recognized expert in their domains within the broader data engineering community and capable of driving significant technical and business impact at enterprise scale.

**What's Next**

* TA Call
* Technical Screening Focused on Python and SQL
* Technical Screening Focused on Snowflake and dbt
* Final Interview - Whiteboarding Design Round

title: Data Engineer 10
description:
**Job Summary**
Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.
  
  
**Competencies**
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.
  
  
Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.
  
  
Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  
  
Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
  
  
Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
  
  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities.
  
  
Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:
  
  

* Exposure to Big Data open source
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
* SQL query language
* Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
* Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment
* Exposure to Agile software development
* Exposure to building analytical solutions
* Exposure to IoT technology

Core Responsibilities Unique to the Role
  
  

* Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains. 2) Apply Data-as-a-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers. 3)

Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.
  
  
**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud-based technologies. 2) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise-scale data products. 3) Ability to translate business and product requirements into efficient technical solutions while considering scalability, performance, maintainability, and reusability. 4) Experience working in Agile, cross-functional teams and collaborating effectively with product, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders. 5) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred (Nice To Have) Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience working within a Data-as-a-Product operating model, including exposure to data catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and certified data products. 2) Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI initiatives, including preparation of AI-ready datasets, semantic models, knowledge assets, or data structures supporting intelligent business solutions.

description:
**About Us:**
We love going to work and think you should too. Our team is dedicated to trust, customer obsession, agility, and striving to be better everyday. We foster a culture of performance and recognition, allowing us to transform growth as we enable our employees to do the best work of their careers.

You'll be working in a major tech center of Pune, India. Across the globe, our Centers of Energy serve as hubs where we accelerate productivity and collaboration, inspire creativity, and cultivate a culture of connection and celebration. Our teams coordinate their time in Centers of Energy to reflect how they work best.
  
  
To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our Careers Page.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.
  
  
Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!
  
  
This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for a prompt engineer who helps deliver dependable enterprise AI solutions for defined go-to-market and business problems. You will build on the AI Fabric—the shared foundation for governed execution, trusted context, reusable integrations, and observability—and use automation plus code to deliver workflows people can rely on.
  
  
You will work across prompts, models, context, data, tool and API integrations, workflow automation, evaluations, and operational controls. This is not a prompt-only role: you will apply established platform patterns to build and improve well-scoped solutions, partnering with stakeholders and the appropriate technical owners from use-case definition through launch, measurement, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Here's a closer look at this key role:**

* Partner with stakeholders to clarify defined go-to-market and business use cases, then build and deliver enterprise AI solutions on the shared AI Fabric using established patterns, approved connections, and agreed scope. Contribute improvements rather than creating one-off or parallel implementations.
* Apply and iteratively improve established prompt, system-instruction, structured-output, tool-use, model-routing, and context-window practices so outputs are useful, grounded, predictable, and fit for a business workflow.
* Build and support n8n or comparable automation workflows using established patterns for triggers, APIs, webhooks, human approvals, retries, fallbacks, scheduled jobs, and error handling. Contribute Python, Strands SDK, or other lightweight code when a workflow needs approved custom logic or durable runtime behavior.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems and governed data sources such as Slack, Salesforce, Gong, Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, Snowflake, AWS services, and internal APIs. Pull, join, and validate data from the appropriate tables while applying established access, data-handling, and audit standards.
* Apply established context and data standards to select the approved sources for a use case; shape, prioritize, and refresh context; manage context-window limits; support permission-aware retrieval; and keep response behavior grounded in source data. Escalate new source, access, or architecture decisions to the appropriate owners.
* Apply established decision criteria for LLM-driven and deterministic components. For example, use models for language understanding and generation while relying on SQL, rules, validated APIs, and calculation services for financial, policy, or data-accuracy-critical operations; escalate new architectural tradeoffs when needed.
* Apply existing evaluation and quality controls, including representative test sets, regression tests, LLM-as-judge or deterministic scoring, failure taxonomies, prompt and retrieval experiments, and release criteria. Contribute evidence and improvements to the shared evaluation approach.
* Use approved observability and operational practices for production solutions, including structured logs, outcome and quality metrics, token and cost visibility, audit trails, alerting, troubleshooting guidance, and feedback loops.
* Apply privacy, security, and reliability controls such as data minimization, PII redaction or placeholder restoration where appropriate, secrets management, schema validation, human-in-the-loop gates, graceful degradation, and least-privilege integration patterns.
* Work directly with senior go-to-market and business stakeholders, product, data, security, and engineering teams to clarify use cases, translate approved requirements into practical solution designs, surface risks and tradeoffs to the appropriate owners, and use observed usage to improve solutions.
* Contribute reusable technical modules, templates, and documentation that help future AI Fabric and n8n solutions be faster, safer, and easier to support.

**What You'll Need:**

* 4+ years of experience in prompt engineering, software engineering, data or automation engineering, AI/ML engineering, solutions engineering, or a comparable hands-on technical role.
* Demonstrated experience building and improving production-oriented LLM applications, AI agents, RAG systems, semantic search, structured-output pipelines, or AI workflow automations.
* Strong prompt-engineering judgment: able to design prompt and output contracts, diagnose failures, run controlled experiments, and choose when prompting alone is insufficient.
* Working knowledge of workflow automation concepts and tools such as n8n or comparable platforms, including integrations, webhooks, error handling, retries, and operational support; able to learn and apply the team's n8n standards.
* Working proficiency in SQL and practical ability to write queries that select, join, aggregate, and validate data from tables. Working knowledge of relational databases, schemas, data quality, and the tradeoffs of using governed data sources.
* Ability to use Python and/or JavaScript or TypeScript for API integration, data transformation, automation, and AI workflow implementation.
* Experience integrating APIs, SaaS platforms, webhooks, cloud services, and enterprise data systems with appropriate authentication, secrets, logging, error-handling, and data-access practices.
* Experience applying context-engineering and retrieval concepts including established source-selection practices, embeddings, chunking, metadata, permission-aware retrieval, source attribution, refresh patterns, context-window management, and grounding techniques.
* A rigorous testing and evaluation mindset, including test datasets, regression testing, output validation, and measurable quality metrics.
* Ability to work directly and credibly with senior stakeholders: clarify a business use case, communicate solution design, implementation status, risk, and tradeoffs, and support adoption with both technical and non-technical partners.

title: Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
This role shapes the end-to-end design and delivery of resilient cloud-native data platforms and microservices. You’ll set technical direction across modernisation of legacy estates while staying close enough to the code to unblock teams and strengthen engineering quality in Java and distributed system design. The focus spans high-performance data pipelines, event-driven integration and production-ready operational standards in a regulated environment. Success means services that are scalable, observable and secure with clear roadmaps that reduce risk and disruption to live operations. You’ll influence senior stakeholders by translating business outcomes into pragmatic technical plans and measurable milestones.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Own solution architecture for high-performance data pipelines and microservices including resilience, scalability, latency, observability and security
* Define modernisation roadmaps across re-platforming, refactoring and microservices decomposition with minimal disruption to live services
* Establish engineering standards for API design, event-driven integration, data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD and operational readiness
* Manage technical debt through clear prioritisation and measurable outcomes
* Architect, design and build core services using Java (8+), Spring Boot 3, JPA and PostgreSQL (or other RDBMS) using event streaming patterns
* Deliver real-time processing implementations using Apache Flink and/or Apache Beam where appropriate
* Partner with engineers on code reviews, pair debugging, performance tuning and production incident resolution
* Own operational excellence on GCP across monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, reliability improvements and cost optimisation

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring substantial software engineering experience designing and delivering distributed systems and data-intensive applications
* Demonstrate recent hands-on Java engineering expertise using Spring Boot with REST and event-driven services
* Apply proven system design across microservices patterns, asynchronous messaging, idempotency, consistency models, caching, rate limiting and failure handling
* Show strong SQL capability including performance tuning and working effectively with ORM frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate
* Deliver cloud-native solutions on GCP or an equivalent cloud platform with the ability to translate patterns and services
* Troubleshoot across application, data, infrastructure and performance layers to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence
* Communicate architecture decisions clearly and connect them to business priorities and operational constraints
* Coach and mentor engineers across levels to strengthen craftsmanship, accountability and continuous improvement

Building resilient data services
  
  
If you want to shape modern cloud-native platforms while staying hands-on with Java engineering this role offers real scope to make a visible difference. You’ll set direction for microservices and data pipelines that need to perform under demanding production conditions. The work spans architecture, delivery and operational excellence so improvements show up in reliability, scalability and engineering efficiency. If this aligns with the kind of platform work you want to own we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
