**and Marketing Resource Management**
platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Architecture & Governance**

* Own the long-term architectural roadmap for the Aprimo DAM and MRM platform - taxonomy evolution, metadata schema strategy, integration architecture, and AI capability adoption.
* Define and enforce enterprise-wide DAM and MRM governance standards: naming conventions, field design principles, classification ownership models, and change management processes.
* Review data models, taxonomies, and metadata structures within Aprimo MRM and DAM to ensure accurate reporting, data quality, and future extensibility.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders to translate complex marketing and compliance requirements into detailed Aprimo configuration blueprints and solution documents.
* Define governance guidelines for Aprimo configuration standards, naming conventions, and usage policies so that global teams follow consistent practices.

**🆕**
**MRM - Marketing Planning & Financial Management**

* Configure and manage Aprimo MRM's marketing planning and budgeting modules - including plan hierarchies, activity types, budget structures, and fiscal year setup aligned to enterprise marketing operating models.
* Design and maintain MRM financial workflows including budget request, approval, allocation, accrual, and reconciliation processes - ensuring finance and marketing teams operate from a single source of truth.
* Build and govern MRM project and activity templates that standardise how marketing programmes are initiated, tracked, and closed across global teams.
* Configure MRM work management capabilities - task management, project timelines, resource assignments, and capacity planning - to support marketing operations teams.
* Design MLR (Medical/Legal/Review) and compliance-driven approval workflows within Aprimo MRM for regulated industries, including routing rules, version locking, and audit trail requirements.
* Maintain and evolve MRM field design - custom fields, picklists, calculated fields, and conditional logic - ensuring that data captured at the plan and activity level supports downstream reporting needs.
* Define and enforce MRM data governance standards for plan naming conventions, cost centre mapping, vendor management, and invoice processing workflows.
* Configure and maintain MRM reporting and dashboard frameworks - including standard and custom reports across budget performance, activity status, resource utilisation, and campaign ROI.
* Manage MRM user role and permission architecture - defining role hierarchies, team structures, and access scoping aligned to organisational and regional team models.
* Support MRM integrations with finance and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget synchronisation, purchase order management, invoice reconciliation, and financial close processes.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of DAM Specialists, Analysts, MRM Administrators, and Integration Developers - setting technical direction and reviewing their configuration and integration work.
* Lead development teams by providing detailed interface specifications, mapping documents, and solution use cases that reduce implementation rework.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews for API integrations, ensuring adherence to security, performance, and maintainability standards.

**DAM Configuration & Taxonomy**

* Configure Aprimo DAM capabilities to streamline asset intake, metadata modeling, and governance processes that improve asset discoverability and reuse.
* Design and maintain a scalable, organisation-wide taxonomy (classification hierarchy) aligned to how marketing teams browse and search for assets.

**Integration Architecture**

* Own the end-to-end integration architecture connecting Aprimo to the broader MarTech and enterprise systems landscape (CMS, PIM, CRM, marketing automation, CDN).
* Design and build API-based integrations using the Aprimo REST API - including asset ingestion pipelines, metadata synchronisation, and event-driven workflows.
* Design and build MRM API integrations - including marketing plan data synchronisation, activity status feeds, budget and spend data pipelines, and bi-directional connectors with finance and ERP platforms.
* Implement OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, manage API client registrations, and maintain secure credential handling for all service accounts.
* Develop and maintain webhook configurations for event-driven integrations with downstream systems (CMS, PIM, email platforms, CDN).
* Build and maintain bulk asset ingestion pipelines handling multi-step processes: record creation, chunked file upload, metadata mapping, commit, and error handling.
* Implement and maintain the Aprimo Content Selector SDK within third-party applications - ensuring scoped authorisation, rendition control, and audit logging.

**Migration**

* Lead asset migration projects from legacy DAM systems or shared drives into Aprimo - including source audit, de-duplication, metadata mapping, and validation.
* Lead MRM data migration projects from legacy marketing planning tools, spreadsheets, or prior MRM platforms into Aprimo - including plan and activity data mapping, historical budget data migration, open workflow migration, and user acceptance validation.

**Aprimo certification is a plus.**
**Experience**

* 6–7 years total professional experience, including a minimum of 4–5 years of dedicated, hands-on Aprimo DAM and/or MRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience as the senior/lead technical resource on at least one full Aprimo implementation or major platform transformation - not merely a contributor.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring Aprimo MRM modules - including marketing planning, budget management, work management, and approval workflow design - at an enterprise scale.
* Proven ownership of enterprise taxonomy and metadata architecture decisions - able to speak to specific trade-offs made and their long-term consequences.
* Deep, verifiable hands-on expertise with the Aprimo REST API - must be able to design integration architecture from scratch, not just describe individual endpoint calls.
* Experience leading or mentoring a team of DAM analysts, specialists, MRM administrators, or developers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated industry (pharmaceutical, financial services, healthcare) with MLR/compliance-driven workflow design - including MRM-side review routing and audit trail configuration.
* Experience owning a DAM or MRM platform migration at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with Aprimo Content Selector SDK, Agentic Orchestration (Copilot Studio, n8n, MCP Server), and emerging AI-driven DAM capabilities.
* Experience with enterprise identity/access architecture - SCIM provisioning, SSO integration, federated permission models.

+ Lambda
+ API Gateway
+ ECR
+ S3
+ RDS

Containerization & DevOps

* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and release automation methodologies.

+ CloudWatch
+ Prometheus
+ Grafana

Software Engineering

* Expertise in API design and integration patterns (REST and GraphQL).
* Experience with relational databases, ORM frameworks, and data modeling.

AI & Innovation

title: Data Migration Lead
description:
Data Migration Lead

Location Pune, Maharashtra, India

Work Arrangement Hybrid, with a preference for candidates who can work from the Pune office at least 2–3 days per week

Experience 7–10 years

Role Overview

The Data Migration Lead owns the technical migration approach and execution across the Data Migration Engineer team. Working within governance rules established by the onshore team, this role coordinates cleansing and deduplication methodology, migration-wave sequencing, and reconciliation accuracy. The lead reviews and signs off on migration work before it moves to QA and serves as the technical contact for migration-specific matters raised by the client’s Data Governance Lead.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the technical approach and execution of data migration across the Data Migration Engineer team.

• Define data-cleansing and deduplication methodology in accordance with governance rules established by the onshore team.

• Plan and sequence migration waves to support controlled and accurate migration execution.

• Oversee reconciliation activities and ensure accuracy at scale.

• Review and sign off on migration engineers’ deliverables before submission to QA.

• Act as the technical point of contact for migration-specific issues raised by the client’s Data Governance Lead.

• Manage and coordinate a team of migration engineers, supporting delivery across the migration lifecycle.

Required Skills and Experience

• 7–10 years of experience in data migration and/or Master Data Management (MDM).

• Experience with at least one large-scale pharmaceutical master data migration.

• Strong people-management experience, including running teams of approximately 8–15 engineers.

• Ability to oversee data cleansing, deduplication, migration sequencing, and reconciliation.

Work Location and Arrangement

This role is based in Pune, Maharashtra, with a hybrid working arrangement. Pune is the first preference, and candidates should be able to attend the office at least 2–3 days per week as required.

title: Data Architect
description:
**Job Role:**
Data Architect – Data & Insights

**Location:**
Pune/Hyderabad/Bangalore/Mumbai/Noida

**Position Type:**
Full-time

**Summary**

We are looking for a highly experienced
**Data Architect (Grade 7B)**
to lead the design and delivery of the enterprise Data & Insights platform on
**Microsoft Azure**
. The role demands deep expertise in
**cloud data architecture**
,
**data models**
,
**data lake/lakehouse**
,
**vector-store based RAG systems**
,
**GenAI**
,
**Agentic AI**
, and governance using
**Microsoft Purview**
.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on skills in
**Python**
,
**LangChain**
,
**LangGraph**
, Azure data services, and end-to-end SDLC execution.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Architect and design Azure-based
  **data lake/lakehouse platforms**
  , domain data models, and ingestion-to-consumption pipelines.
* Develop conceptual, logical, and physical
  **cloud data models**
  aligned with enterprise standards.
* Architect
  **RAG pipelines**
  including embeddings, chunking, vector stores, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and evaluation.
* Build
  **Agentic AI workflows**
  using LangChain and LangGraph; design tool orchestration, memory, and safety layers.
* Implement governance with
  **Microsoft Purview**
  for cataloging, lineage, PII tagging, and policy enforcement.
* Ensure platform security using Entra ID, private endpoints, VNETs, Key Vault, and encryption controls.
* Lead solution architecture reviews, performance tuning, cost optimization, and NFR engineering.
* Oversee CI/CD (Azure DevOps), IaC (Terraform/Bicep), and observability (Azure Monitor, App Insights).
* Mentor engineering teams and standardize best practices, patterns, and reusable components.

**Technical Skills**

**Mandatory**

* **Azure Data Platform**
  : ADLS Gen2, Synapse/Serverless SQL, Databricks/Spark, ADF/Synapse Pipelines
* **Programming**
  : Python, PySpark, SQL
* **GenAI & Agentic AI**
  : RAG architecture, vector stores (Azure Cognitive Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant), embeddings, reranking
* **Frameworks**
  : LangChain, LangGraph
* **Data Modeling**
  : Conceptual/logical/physical models, Delta/Parquet patterns, lakehouse modeling
* **Data Governance**
  : Microsoft Purview (catalog, lineage, classification, glossary, PII governance)
* **Security**
  : Entra ID, RBAC/ABAC, Key Vault, VNET integration, encryption
* **SDLC & DevOps**
  : Azure DevOps (CI/CD), Terraform/Bicep, ADRs, HLD/LLD documentation
* **Performance & Cost Optimization**
  across compute, storage, vector workloads, and pipelines

**Preferred**

* Azure Fabric / OneLake; Power BI semantic modeling
* dbt for transformations and testing
* Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server MI
* Knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and graph-based retrieval
* LLMOps: evaluation, telemetry, safety assessment, drift monitoring
* FinOps optimization practices
* Multi-cloud experience (AWS/GCP equivalents)
* API design: REST, GraphQL, gRPC

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline.
* Total experience with
  **minimum 5+ years**
  in cloud data architecture.
* Proven experience delivering
  **Azure-based**
  data platforms and production-grade
  **GenAI/RAG systems**
  .

title: Data Platform Engineer Manager
description:

To support this mission, Syngenta’s IT & Digital team is seeking a Engineering Lead - Data & Analytics in Pune. This role will support the delivery for leading data and engineering teams within our Data Mesh platform, oversee product delivery, and spearhead the modernization of our AI, BI, and agentic analytics solutions.

* The Data Platform Engineer Manager is responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving enterprise‑scale , Databricks based data mesh platform at Syngenta.

* Ability to orchestrate efforts needed to prioritize business initiatives across complex change agendas

* Problem solving and decision making skills
* Teamwork, team management and leadership skills

**Qualifications**
**Qualification & Experience Level**

* B.tech/M.tech
* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or architecture.

Employee may, as part of his/her role and maybe through multifunctional teams, participate in the creation and design of innovative solutions. title: Sr Lead, SW Eng
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced, self-motivated application developer senior who is technically very strong with strong background, in Collibra metadata management tool, and has deep knowledge of workflow development programming, experience configuring, experience with Collibra, Customizing and integrating data across multiple platforms. Typical activities include developing business process workflows, developing integration between Collibra and other systems, configuring Collibra per business requirements, code/configuration migration between different environments. Production monitoring, creating monitoring dashboards, setting up alerts, triaging alerts. In this role, person will be responsible for creating and driving the technical vision for the team that designs, develops, tests, and operates our platform services end to end. Working with Business analysts, Other Developers and other cross functional team to implement, customize and integrate data across multiple platforms.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Implement Collibra Workflows to enable data management capabilities
* Developing integration between Collibra and other systems leveraging Collibra API
* Configuring Collibra per business requirements
* Partner with Data Stewards for requirements, integrations and processes, participate in meetings and working sessions
* Partner with Data Management and integration leads to continuously improve Data Management technologies and processes
* Outline and apply software development best practices
* Responsible for Data governance
* Responsible for upgrades and future developments of Data Governance tool suites.

**Core Technology & Domain Skills**

* Data Governance & Quality: Collibra Enterprise Catalog, Collibra Data Quality, metadata management, technical lineage, data quality, data products, regulatory data governance
* Cloud & DevOps : Microsoft Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Terraform, containerized applications, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure
* Data Platforms : Snowflake, PostgreSQL, SQL, Enterprise data bases, ETL/Data Integration
* Engineering & Automation : Python, SQL, REST APIs, Shell Scripting, infrastructure automation
* Security & Operations: RBAC, vulnerability remediation, certificates, secrets, DLP, Azure Policy, disaster recovery, backup, production support, incident/change management.

**Candidate Requirements**

* At least 8 years of Collibra experience. Collibra experience Mandatory. Computer Science degree preferred Requires 11+ years’ experience in the IT industry
* Knowledge of Data Governance, Data Lineage and Data Management.
* Experience leading multiple Collibra implementations
* Experience with metamodel design
* Experience and strong proficiency with workflow development tools.
* Familiarity with code repository and version control tools such as Bitbucket
* Experience with REST/API.
* Strong SQL background with many RDBMS such as: SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres
* Knowledge of NoSQL DB.
* Experience in working with Linux environment.
* Ability to work well with a team in a fast-paced agile development environment.
* Bachelor’s in computer science or equivalent work experience.
* Excellent communication, analytical and problem-solving skills
* Extensive understanding in SDLC and scrum methodologies.
* Collibra experience: Scratch implementation experience

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Gen AI Architect
description:
T
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a GenAI Solution Architect / AI Data Architect with deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI-first data architecture, and large-scale data engineering platforms. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing end-to-end AI and data ecosystems that support enterprise-grade GenAI applications, while providing overall technical leadership across solution architecture, data platforms, security, and scalability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define system architecture tailored for LLM execution, managing multi-layer database models (raw, stg, core, fact, mart) and context window design in close collaboration with the client POC
* Architect resilient ingestion pipelines for high-volume public APIs, BigQuery historical backfills, social scrapers, and AI-driven entity resolution engines.
* Establish strict physical data boundary rules between shared data pools and isolated client environments.
* Set protocols for system fallback behaviour, rate-limiting, cost caps, and agentic health monitoring.
* Deep expertise in AI-era database architecture (BigQuery/SQL), prompt/system design, data security, and high-throughput data pipelines, RAG systems
* Prepare HLD/LLD/Deployment diagram and other required documentation with the support from tech lead
* Provide overall technical oversight to the team
* Brainstorming with the client POCs for the future roadmap, create prototypes to check feasibility of upcoming GenAI innovations in the industry
* Mentor team in overall GenAI solutioning to ensure they are following industry best practices

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of experience in solution architecture, data engineering, or enterprise application development.
* Strong expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI systems, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Hands-on experience designing AI architectures using modern LLM ecosystems and prompt engineering techniques.
* Strong experience building high-throughput, fault-tolerant ETL/ELT and streaming data pipelines.
* Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, and knowledge graph solutions.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
* Understanding of AI system monitoring, evaluation frameworks, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and model governance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise AI platforms leveraging BigQuery, Vertex AI, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, or equivalent LLM platforms.
* Exposure to AI agents, autonomous workflows, multi-agent systems, and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Knowledge of MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD pipelines, model lifecycle management, and AI observability tools.
* Experience in data lineage, metadata management, and enterprise data governance frameworks.
* Prior experience leading GenAI transformation initiatives or innovation programs within enterprise environments.

title: SENIOR CONSULTANT - DELIVERY

From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

This is an individual contributor role, not a team lead or people-management position. You lead through technical depth: owning hard problems, setting a high bar for quality, and helping the engineers around you do their best work.

**Requirements**

* Production experience in at least two of Python, TypeScript, Elixir, and C#, and the comfort to pick up the rest.
* A strong testing mindset: you design for testability and treat automated tests as part of the work.

* Experience owning services in production, including deployments, monitoring, and incident response.

* Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality.
* Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
* Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together.
* Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
* Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes.
* Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive and web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers.
* Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a relational database, a type of database that stores and organizes data in a structured way and where data is logically interrelated. This skill often requires proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and understanding of database design principles.
* Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding.
* 7+ years of overall experience in data engineering or related fields.
* 5+ years of experience building data pipelines for structured and unstructured data.
* 2+ years of experience with big data technologies including PySpark, Hadoop, Kafka, EventHub, and Stream Analytics.
* 3+ years of experience in relational and dimensional data modeling using SQL Server and data warehousing concepts.
* 3+ years of experience with T-SQL, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
* 3+ years of experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL DB, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Good to have 2+ years of experience with Azure ML, Python, and Scala.
* Good to have 2+ years of experience with Power BI and Azure Analysis Services.
* Experience working with business stakeholders for requirements gathering and use case analysis.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and creative problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Azure Data Engineer Certification or equivalent is a strong advantage.

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: AI CoE Senior Data Engineer & Architect
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is a global leader in cloud-based enterprise solutions, empowering businesses to adapt faster and thrive in an increasingly dynamic, digital world. With a strong focus on innovation and AI-driven insights, QAD is shaping the future of enterprise transformation across industries. We foster a flexible, inclusive culture where bold ideas and future-focused talent to drive real impact. Join us to help build the intelligent, connected enterprise of tomorrow.
  
  
This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune, with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.
  
  
**Job Description**

* About the team

QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the
  
  
organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed,
  
  
measured, production workflows across priority business functions.
  
  
The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. AI Engagement Specialists own the demand side with the
  
  
functions; the AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer build the platform and the agents; AI Operations owns the
  
  
run side. The Senior Data Engineer & Architect owns what every agent depends on: getting the right data to agents, current, governed and in a shape they can use.
  
  

* Why this role exists

Every AI use case in the CoE portfolio depends on data: from sales and customer systems, from support and
  
  
engineering knowledge sources, and from delivery and operational systems. Before an agent can use it, that
  
  
data has to be joined, current, governed and checked against what each user is allowed to see.
  
  
This role makes data a shared, reusable capability of the AI CoE rather than something rebuilt for each use
  
  
case. It owns the data layer at feasibility and development) stages and keeps the data running after go-live.
  
  
Role overview
  
  
The AI CoE Senior Data Engineer & Architect owns the data layer of the AI lifecycle. You will assess data
  
  
feasibility for each new use case, build and run the pipelines that feed the AI platform, model the semantic
  
  
layer that agents query instead of raw tables, and make sure every agent sees only the data its user is
  
  
allowed to see.This is a hands-on engineering role with production ownership, measured on agents getting correct, current and permitted data, and on each new use case reaching data-ready faster than the last.
  
  

* Where this role sits

Reports to Head of the AI Centre of Excellence
  
  
Works with Senior AI Engineer daily; AI Architect on reference architecture; AI
  
  
Engagement Specialist on data feasibility; AI Ops Lead on pipeline health
  
  
and cost; system integrators; data owners in each function; Security and
  
  
GRC
  
  
Owns Data feasibility assessments, AI data pipelines and connectors, semantic
  
  
models and metrics for AI use, retrieval-ready knowledge sources, data
  
  
access patterns for agents, and data freshness and quality targets
  
  
QAD | Redzone — AI CoE Data Engineer
  
  

* AI Centre of Excellence

Accountable for Correct, current, governed data for every agent in production, measured
  
  
on freshness, quality, reuse of semantic models and time from PRD
  
  
approval to data-ready
  
  
**Location India**

* What you will own
* Data feasibility and readiness
* Assess the data behind every PRD before build is approved: sources, owners, volumes, quality, access

paths and gaps, written up as a data readiness view the stage gate can act on, with what is missing, stale
  
  
or not permitted and options to fix it.
  
  
Pipelines and integration
  
  

* Build and run the pipelines that feed the AI platform (on AWS today) and the warehouses agents query,

such as BigQuery or Redshift, with incremental and, where it matters, event-driven sync.
  
  

* Close freshness gaps: know how long a new record or document takes to reach an agent, set a target

with the business, and meet it. Handle deletions and permission changes, not just new records.
  
  

* Build and maintain connectors with the system integrators, so each new source is added once and

reused across use cases.
  
  
Semantic layer
  
  

* Model the business entities and metrics agents need in the semantic layer, so agents query governed

definitions agreed with data owners, consistent with what dashboards report, instead of writing SQL
  
  
against raw tables.
  
  

* Put guardrails on structured queries: read-only access, row limits, timeouts and cost limits for any agent

that queries data.
  
  

* Retrieval-ready knowledge
* Prepare unstructured sources for retrieval with the Senior AI Engineer: metadata, release and version

tags, access tags, and structure that keeps the source context intact; build and maintain the golden
  
  
datasets used to test retrieval and answer quality.
  
  
Data access, security and governance
  
  

* Make agents act as the user: user-scoped access, row and column-level security in the semantic layer,

and no over-privileged shared service accounts.
  
  

* Handle sensitive data properly with Security and GRC: classification, masking of personal and customer

data in tickets, residency rules for regulated regions, lineage and audit evidence.
  
  
Run and improve (L5)
  
  

* Own pipeline health in production: freshness and quality monitoring, alerts someone acts on, and fast

recovery when a source system changes its schema; with AI Ops, keep processing, storage and
  
  
embedding spend per use case in check.
  
  

* Turn each build into reusable data products so the next use case starts from shared models and

connectors, not from scratch.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Essential
* 8+ years in data engineering, including at least 3 years building data for ML, analytics or Gen AI products

running in production.
  
  

* Strong SQL and Python, and pipeline orchestration in practice, for example Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue or

similar.
  
  

* Cloud data platforms: Azure , AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift, RDS) and/or Google BigQuery.
* Semantic and dimensional modelling: hands-on with a semantic or metrics layer such as Cube, dbt

Semantic Layer, LookML or Power BI semantic models.
  
  

* Incremental and event-driven ingestion: change data capture, webhooks or streaming, and handling

deletes and late-arriving data.
  
  

* Data for retrieval: document ingestion, metadata design and hybrid or vector search (for example

OpenSearch, Elasticsearch or pgvector), and enough understanding of embeddings to work with an AI
  
  
engineer.
  
  

* Data security in practice: role-based access, row and column-level security, handling personal data, and

cloud identity and access management.
  
  

* API integration with enterprise SaaS, such as CRM and Atlassian REST APIs.
* Data quality discipline: tests, freshness and quality monitoring, and service-level targets for data.
* Clear communication with data owners and business teams: able to explain what the data can and

cannot support, and why.
  
  

* Data depth

We are looking for someone who has run pipelines in production and lived with the consequences, and can
  
  
tell when an agent's wrong answer is really a data problem.
  
  
Strongly preferred
  
  

* Sales and customer data, support and engineering knowledge data, or ERP and manufacturing data;

Progress OpenEdge familiarity is a plus.
  
  

* Experience with an enterprise RAG or AI platform, and with exposing data to agents through APIs or

MCP tools.
  
  

* Working alongside system integrators and a central data team, and across time zones; enterprise B2B

SaaS experience.
  
  

* What this role is not
* Not a BI developer. Dashboards are owned by the functions and AI Ops; you make the data behind them

and the agents trustworthy.
  
  

* Not the owner of the enterprise data platform. You work with the central data team and reuse their

assets, and build what AI use cases need on top.
  
  

* Not an AI engineer. Agent logic, prompts and models sit with the Senior AI Engineer; you own the data

they depend on.
  
  
QAD | Redzone — AI CoE Data Engineer
  
  

* AI Centre of Excellence
* Not a one-off integration contractor. You own the pipelines and semantic models in production, after

go-live.
  
  
What success looks like
  
  
First 3 months
  
  

* Data feasibility assessments completed for the priority use cases.
* A data readiness checklist built into the stage gates and used on every new use case.
* An agreed access pattern with Security for user-scoped data, and freshness measured for priority data

sources.
  
  

* Semantic layer version 1 live for the priority domain, used by production agents.
* Freshness and quality targets set and monitored for every production data source.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Data Platforms)-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Data Engineer (Data Platforms)-1
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**About The Role**
Mastercard's Data Commercialization Platform team is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build the platform's self-service experience and automated control layer. The goal is to replace manual, multi-team request processes with a governed, intuitive experience, and to extend it with data-intensive and AI-powered capabilities.
  
  
This is a hands-on, end-to-end engineering role. It covers everything from the user-facing web experience down to the data, API and cloud layers underneath, in a multi-cloud environment.
  
  
The platform provisions and governs cloud and lakehouse infrastructure for enterprise users. The role requires deep expertise in cloud platforms, including compute, networking, identity, storage and security. Candidates must understand how these services work together to deliver scalable, secure and reliable solutions.
  
  
**All About You**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). You have 6+ years of experience building scalable, reliable data platforms and software in agile environments, using distributed systems, microservices and RESTful APIs.
  
  
Experience building and operating modern data and lakehouse platforms using Python, Spark/PySpark, Databricks, Unity Catalog, Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake, object storage, and workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.
  
  
Strong end-to-end application development skills. This means building back-end services in Java (Core Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs) and the web experiences on top of them in React and TypeScript/JavaScript, with attention to responsive design, accessibility and performance.
  
  
Deep hands-on cloud engineering experience on AWS and/or Azure, including Kubernetes, networking, identity and access management, storage, security, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK), CI/CD, observability, and cost optimization.
  
  
Experience designing workflow orchestration platforms, automation frameworks, or long-running stateful processes. This includes retries, idempotency, reconciliation, and integration with external systems through REST or GraphQL APIs.
  
  
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, query optimization, caching, asynchronous processing, and application scalability patterns.
  
  
Experience with streaming and distributed data technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Trino, EMR, or Snowflake is a plus.
  
  
Exposure to AI-powered development, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic frameworks, and evaluation techniques.
  
  
Strong engineering fundamentals, including secure coding practices, access control models, automated testing, observability, and troubleshooting across UI, API, data, and cloud layers.
  
  
Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs, contribute to architecture and design discussions, and explain complex solutions to engineering, security, platform and business stakeholders.
  
  
Experience using AI coding assistants and modern developer productivity tools to speed up delivery and improve code quality.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Us:**

At Calfus, we are known for delivering cutting-edge AI agents and products that transform businesses in ways previously unimaginable. We empower companies to harness the full potential of AI, unlocking opportunities they never imagined possible before the AI era. Our software engineering teams are highly valued by customers, whether start-ups or established enterprises, because we consistently deliver solutions that drive revenue growth. Our ERP solution teams have successfully implemented cloud solutions and developed tools that seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, reducing manual work so teams can focus on high-impact tasks.

None of this would be possible without talent like you! Our global teams thrive on collaboration, and we’re actively looking for skilled professionals to strengthen our in-house expertise and help us deliver exceptional AI, software engineering, and solutions using enterprise applications.

As one of the fastest-growing companies in our industry, we take pride in fostering a culture of innovation where new ideas are always welcomed—without hesitation. We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high-energy, driven individuals.

To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey!

**About the Role**

As a Senior / Lead Data Engineer, you'll own the design and delivery of our cloud data platforms on AWS and Azure. You'll architect Lakehouse solutions built on Medallion Architecture, set the data modelling standards, and lead a team of data engineers delivering reliable, scalable pipelines. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll make the architecture decisions and still be close enough to the code to write SQL and PySpark yourself. With 8–12 years of experience, you've designed data platforms, not just built pipelines on them.

**What You'll Do**

*Data Architecture & Platform Design*

* Design scalable data lake, lakehouse, and warehouse architectures on AWS and Azure that meet business requirements
* Implement Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) using Databricks and Delta Lake
* Work with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications and architecture designs

*Data Integration & Pipelines*

* Build and oversee ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Airflow, SSIS, or equivalent tools
* Use Azure Databricks and PySpark for large-scale data processing
* Own pipeline reliability — orchestration, monitoring, failure handling, and automation

*Data Modelling*

* Design and maintain dimensional and relational data models (star, snowflake) for analytical workloads
* Own schema design decisions and modelling standards across the platform

*Database Engineering & Performance*

* Write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and transformations
* Optimise pipelines, queries, and Spark jobs for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost

*Data Quality & Governance*

* Implement data quality checks, validation, and governance best practices to ensure accurate and compliant data

*Team Leadership*

* Lead, mentor, and guide data engineers, review code, and build a culture of continuous learning and improvement

**What You'll Need — Must Have**

* 6-12 years in data engineering, including experience leading data engineering teams
* **Strong AWS or Azure experience**
  (S3, Lambda, Glue / ADF, ADLS, Databricks) demonstrated through delivered projects
* **Medallion Architecture**
  — you've designed and implemented bronze/silver/gold layers on Databricks or Delta Lake
* **Data Architecture**
  — you've designed end-to-end data platforms, not only built pipelines on them
* **Data Modelling**
  — you've built dimensional and relational models, not only queried them
* **Advanced SQL**
  — SQL Server, Postgres, Snowflake, or Redshift, including stored procedures and query tuning
* ETL/ELT and orchestration tools such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or Airflow
* Python for data engineering — Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, scripting, and automation
* Experience with databases like Snowflake, Postgres, Redshift, and MongoDB
* Familiarity with data formats like JSON, CSV, Parquet, and Pickle
* Version control (Git), CI/CD, and code quality practices for data engineering projects
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience across both AWS and Azure
* Azure SDK
* Working with REST APIs and web scraping
* Unity Catalog or other data governance and cataloguing tools

**Benefits:**

At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit.

**Calfus is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

We believe diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone—regardless of background, identity, or experience—has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome all applicants!

description:
**Designation :**
Senior AI/DS Engineer

**Required Experience:**

5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

:

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

**7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI**

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

**Required Qualifications and experience:**

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                        

AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience.

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations.

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals.

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations.

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred.

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support.

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope.

title: Vice President / Database Administration Manager
description:
**Company Description**
As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals, and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset-management partner.
  
  
With over 4,400 employees across 51 locations in 25 countries, our people are our advantage. We foster a culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration to create an environment where everyone can thrive and do their best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business, or providing thoughtful advice to clients, we’re looking for unique voices to help lead us forward. If you’re ready to challenge your limits and build your future, join us.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
We are seeking a
***PUNE***
based
***VP Database Operations Manager***
to join our
***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
in Global Technology & Operations.
  
  
**Team/Group Description**
This position operates in a fast-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
  
  
**Role Description**
The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
  
  
**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real-time global decision-making, powers enterprise-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent & ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long-term organizational objectives.

**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise-scale data infrastructure.
  
  
You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high-impact challenges.
  
  
With global scope, mission-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
  
  
**Professional development value of this role**
Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization - such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
  
  
**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
  
  

* Demonstrated success leading large-scale, global or multi-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission-critical system reliability.

**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.

**Skills**

* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase & IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.

**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**

* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

title: ML Operations Engineer - Lead
description:
Job Description: ML Operations Engineer - Lead
  
  
**Department:**
AI & Agent Operations (Day 2), AI Organisation
  
  
**Location:**
Pune, India
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Assistant Director, AI & Agent Operations (Singapore)
  
  
**Team Size:**
2 ML Operations Engineers
  
  
**Work Schedule:**
Rotational Shifts
  
  
**Domain:**
Information Technology (IT)
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced ML Operations Lead to manage the deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization of traditional machine-learning models in production. The role will oversee predictive models across consumer, enterprise (B2B), and network businesses, including customer churn prediction, fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead a team of two engineers in India, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, governance, and operational efficiency while coordinating with the Singapore leadership team. This role focuses on classical MLOps and traditional machine-learning models, not LLMs or Generative AI.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop the India ML Operations team, establishing operational standards, priorities, and delivery timelines.
* Manage production deployment, retraining, validation, and rollback of traditional ML models using CI/CD pipelines and structured validation processes.
* Implement model monitoring to detect data, feature, and concept drift, model decay, and performance degradation; define appropriate retraining triggers and thresholds.
* Establish and maintain model registries and lineage records, including model versions, training datasets, performance baselines, and last-known-good versions.
* Ensure model changes requested by business stakeholders are implemented within agreed timelines and validated before deployment.
* Apply champion-challenger testing, backtesting, and validation gates to ensure model reliability before promoting models to production.
* Monitor model performance using appropriate metrics, including AUC, precision-recall, and other relevant evaluation measures.
* Oversee bias and fairness monitoring for decision-making models, ensuring appropriate transparency and human oversight where required.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering teams on data quality, data freshness, data contracts, and change notifications.
* Coordinate with the Singapore leadership team on deployment schedules, incident management, shared services, and operational standards.
* Report model health, deployment success, operational risks, and portfolio performance against defined KPIs.
* Ensure adherence to data governance, model auditability, and applicable model-risk management requirements.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in ML engineering, MLOps, or data science engineering, including team leadership.
* Hands-on experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining traditional machine-learning models in production.
* Strong experience with model drift detection, retraining pipelines, model validation, and production deployment.
* Proven experience with model CI/CD, model registries, lineage management, and rollback procedures.
* Experience with champion-challenger frameworks, backtesting, and model performance evaluation.
* Strong understanding of model governance, data quality, and bias/fairness monitoring.
* Experience leading engineering teams and communicating effectively with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with telecommunications-scale data and production ML environments.
* Prior experience managing customer churn prediction models.
* Familiarity with predictive use cases such as fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.
* Experience with cloud-based machine-learning platforms.
* Postgraduate qualification in ML/AI, Data Science, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience coordinating with international teams across geographies and time zones.

Key Competencies
  
  

* People leadership, mentoring, and team development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Sound operational judgment and incident management.
* Effective stakeholder communication and business requirement translation.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands and manage production risks.
* Strong coordination skills in a cross-border reporting environment.

Decision-Making Responsibilities
  
  
**Independent Authority**

* Manage India team priorities and operational standards.
* Initiate retraining, model promotion, and rollback decisions within approved validation procedures.
* Take appropriate drift-response actions and escalate data-quality issues to Data Engineering.

**Escalation To Leadership**

* Enterprise risk acceptance and regulatory considerations.
* Cross-functional priorities and standards affecting the wider AI and data ecosystem.
* Headcount, budget, procurement, and changes impacting other platform or data functions.

Key Challenges
  
  

* Maintaining model accuracy and reliability across a diverse production portfolio.
* Managing drift, model decay, and data-quality dependencies with a lean engineering team.
* Coordinating deployments, incidents, and standards across India and Singapore.
* Balancing predictive performance with fairness, transparency, and responsible model use.

title: GTM Engineer (Remote, Full Time) [HR220]
description:

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  
  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  
  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  
  

**About the Role**

  

We are hiring a GTM Engineer to own our lead and account data pipeline end to end, keep our email sending infrastructure healthy, and build scalable GTM workflows. This person will ensure our CRM and outbound systems run on clean, enriched, deduped, and usable data, while building automations in n8n and Clay, and using tools like HubSpot, Apollo, Cognism, Lemlist, NeverBounce, and Bright Data.

* Document workflows and create repeatable, scalable processes

* 3+ years in RevOps/Sales Ops/GTM Ops/Data Ops

**Nice to Have**
